description.value: Oliver Eats is a specialty deli and catering business situated in downtown Oliver, at the centre of the Okanagan's wine country cycling corridor. The shop focuses on quality prepared foods including fresh seafood, charcuterie, cheese, sandwiches, soups, and custom gift baskets — a notch above typical roadside stops for cyclists looking for real food. Online ordering and delivery are available alongside an in-person deli takeaway counter.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content at olivereats.com confirms an active deli/catering business at 6060 Station Street, Oliver BC, corroborating the OSM address and URL. The site explicitly labels offerings as 'Deli Takeaway' and lists online ordering and delivery, confirming takeout; no mention is made of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cycling-specific amenities. OSM carries no phone number, but the website supplies 250-498-3394; the OSM name 'Oliver Eats' differs slightly from the website's consistent use of 'Oliver Eats Ltd.'
